title: ObserveCraft Overview
description: ObserveCraft's own health: ClickHouse, log ingestion, Postgres, background jobs, usage per organization and the estimated cost.

definition.content:
**ObserveCraft watching itself.** Every minute the server measures what keeps this install healthy: ClickHouse (reachable, disk space and its growth, tables, parts, mutations, replication), how far log ingestion is behind Kafka, Postgres connections, the background jobs, what each organization stores and what the install costs. Its **[ObserveCraft] monitors** alert before something breaks; set `OC_HEARTBEAT_URL` to also hear when ObserveCraft itself is down.

Pods, CPU and memory come from the Datadog Agent when it runs in ObserveCraft's namespace. Costs are estimates: the Kubernetes prices in [Kubernetes → Autoscaling settings](/kubernetes/autoscaling) and `OC_SELF_MONITORING_STORAGE_GB_MONTH` (Helm `selfMonitoring.storageGbMonth`) per GB-month.
